selection_rule: G3-G11 false/NA count, then score50, then candidate order; adopt only if strictly ahead of baseline and score60 also higher

paired_day_bootstrap_winner_minus_baseli.interpretation: descriptive; selection is not re-run inside bootstrap

limitation: Leave-day-out estimates cover this candidate-selection round only; repeatedly researched training days are not untouched future out-of-sample evidence.
interpretation: Training point estimates improved; leave-day-out selection score and expectancy did not improve, and paired score intervals include zero. REJECT, candidate only.
candidate_cleanup: Unused min_close_location filter and Q1-Q5 temporary configurations/reports removed after selection; their definitions and outcomes remain in docs/STRATEGY.md.
